legacy.034ebbd52d8f168efcbd16f5ae5a3b526.catalogKey:

- **[{{replicationCount}} replications](/replications):** images, videos, and audio that recreate subjective effects.
- **[{{reportCount}} trip reports](/reports):** first-person accounts of individual experiences.

The tryptamines, and through them the lysergamides, ibogalogs, and beta-carbolines, are all elaborated indoles, so the family underlies a large share of serotonergic psychoactives. The fused benzene-pyrrole ring system is the defining structural feature of the class.

legacy.190b303579751254ca3d5e1f6e14a79bb.catalogKey: Arylalkylamines are a chemical class of organic compounds in which an aromatic ring is joined to an amino group through a short carbon chain. This umbrella covers the phenethylamines, tryptamines, and their many descendants, forming the structural core of most monoaminergic psychoactives. 大家好，我是 [Josie Kins](https://josiekins.xyz)。

最近我才知道，中国最大的精神活性物质百科数据库，是 [PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.rip) 的翻译版，而那个网站是我 2013 年创办的。这些年我已经不参与 [PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.rip) 了；2017 年我离开之后，它就慢慢没落了。

你们把它翻译成中文，我觉得非常棒。作为一份礼物，我想把整个 dose.wiki 数据集完整翻译成简体中文，送给中国的朋友们和 [FreeODwiki](https://freeodwiki.org/)，随你们使用。数据是 JSON 格式，方便机器读取。我还看了你们平台的 [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/SalviaSWC/FreeODwiki)，顺手把它转成了兼容 FreeODwiki Markdown 的格式。

里面包括：

- 完整的物质索引，我认为它比 [PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.rip) 的更全面。
- 完整的主观效应索引，它肯定比 [PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.rip) 上的更新，因为我一直在继续维护它。
- 几套 SVG 分子结构图。
- 我这些年写的各种文章，关于梦、清醒梦、迷幻效应、物质效应，还有很多类似的小东西。

我把网站上所有的文字都整理成了方便下载的数据包给你们。

我觉得这些资料很适合用来补充你们已有的内容。[PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.rip) 上有很多东西是这些专门的数据库之外的，比如神经递质和大脑机制的文章、化学文章、减害文章，dose.wiki 目前还没有对应的内容。但 dose.wiki 上已有的物质条目，比 PsychonautWiki 的要全面和规范得多。我基本上做了一条流水线，把网上关于某种精神活性物质的所有实际资料汇总起来。拿 4-AcO-DMT 来说，大概有十家主要的英文精神活性物质百科各写了一篇，流水线会把它们合成为一篇。这就是为什么 dose.wiki 上每种物质的信息更多，而且规范得多。

里面还有不少 PsychonautWiki 从来没有的东西：试剂检测信息、主观效应信息、更广的物质范围、更详细的历史与文化章节、TripSit 的相互作用与合用数据（方便查询和避开危险组合），还有比老 PsychonautWiki 上任何内容都全面得多的法律地位章节。顺带一提，这还是 0.9 测试版，后面还会有很多。

我考虑过很久要不要在 dose.wiki 上直接提供翻译版本，但真到了做决定的时候，我觉得由我来为一个国家、一种文化维护物质信息的网络基础设施并不明智：作为一个傻乎乎的西方人，说实话这对我来说太陌生了。所以我想，不如把数据集按现在的样子分叉一份，直接送过来。

这次翻译用的是 GLM 5.3 Flash，只花了一美元左右。如果你们更想要繁体中文版，告诉我就行。我们还有 250 篇物质条目在路上，但还没做人工审核，所以先等一等；我可不想给你们 AI 垃圾。等它们完成了我会更新这份数据。

大概就是这样。请享用。你们不用也没关系，我不会介意，只是觉得也许能派上用场。我当然不会中文，不过有在线翻译嘛。有任何问题，随时在 Twitter 上找我。很高兴能和你们合作。 :) <3

legacy.23a6a01aeb3247e275cc314305140101b.catalogKey: Racetams are a chemical class of organic compounds that share a five-membered 2-pyrrolidinone ring, a pyrrolidine ring carrying a single carbonyl group, which is the structure their "-racetam" suffix refers to. Members differ by the groups attached to that ring, most often an acetamide on the ring nitrogen, plus further additions that give the various relatives. Racetams are generally marketed as nootropics, with proposed effects on cognition and memory, though their mechanisms are not fully established. The 2-pyrrolidinone nucleus is the consistent backbone uniting the family.

legacy.33511b14d612f431ef343572816908fe0.catalogKey: Lysergamides are a chemical class of organic compounds that are amides of lysergic acid, a complex four-ring fused ergoline structure containing an indole system embedded within additional rings, giving the molecule a rigid, locked geometry. The defining feature of the class is a carboxamide group at the ergoline 8-position, with individual members varying the amine groups on that amide. Most lysergamides are potent serotonergic psychedelics. Because the ergoline scaffold rigidly holds a tryptamine-like unit in place, lysergamides can be viewed as conformationally constrained relatives of the tryptamines.

legacy.35929332bd7b388b101cfd5f4f5056cea.catalogKey:
Piru is an app for logging doses and writing trip reports, on iPhone, Android and Mac, with an Apple Watch companion. It records what you took, how much, and when, draws estimated effect curves from duration data, and lets you check in on mood and effects as a session goes. A finished session exports as a report, and can fill in dose.wiki's trip report form.

Its substance library works offline, draws on dose.wiki's data, and shows where each field came from. Everything stays on your device, with no account, ads, or analytics, and it can import journals from the PsychonautWiki app.

Piru is made by [kageroumado](https://github.com/kageroumado) and [pharmacykitty](https://github.com/pharmacykitty). The iPhone beta is on [TestFlight](https://kagerou.glass/get/piru/ios?from=dosewiki); the [Android app](https://kagerou.glass/get/piru/android?from=dosewiki) and the [Mac app](https://kagerou.glass/get/piru/mac?from=dosewiki) are free downloads from GitHub.

legacy.3668c7855d98be0981b9dac9f9b28f79d.catalogKey: Nitazepynes are a chemical class of organic compounds derived from the core nitazene structure, in which the flexible ethylamine sidechain is replaced by an azetidine or pyrrolidine ring. They otherwise retain the 2-benzylbenzimidazole scaffold of the parent nitazenes and act as agonists at the mu-opioid receptor. legacy.36bc69d5ab5c497041ba926f369b52fa1.catalogKey: **Antidepressants** are a class of psychoactive medications that treat depression and related conditions. Most antidepressants slow the reabsorption of serotonin or noradrenaline in the brain, which keeps more of it active over time. For this reason, they have no immediate effect and take weeks to work. An antidepressant is not the opposite of a "depressant" drug. The two words use "depress" in different senses: one refers to the mood disorder, and the other refers to a slower nervous system.

legacy.4124bc2ea3625d745b58b9f9ac7144fa0.catalogKey: Cannabinoids are a structurally diverse chemical class whose members are united by activity at the cannabinoid receptors rather than by a single common skeleton. The classical phytocannabinoid members share a dibenzopyran-type framework in which an aromatic ring bearing a hydroxyl and a long alkyl chain is fused to an oxygen-containing pyran ring and a carbocyclic terpene-derived ring. Synthetic cannabinoids often abandon this scaffold entirely, linking core groups such as indole or indazole rings through amide or ester linkers to assorted tail and head groups. Members act predominantly as cannabinoid receptor agonists, producing effects that range from mild relaxation to intense intoxication, and the class spans several distinct structural families.

legacy.4ebdf0cc91f72e2f68932f643a12d7522.catalogKey:
Multisensory effects are any subjective effect which directly alters two or more senses simultaneously.

For example, while experiences with autonomous entities may sometimes have a tactile component to them, more often than not they are primarily a visual experience and are therefore classified as such.

legacy.55e18377ec1d334201adc2941396c14fe.catalogKey: Benzodiazepines are a chemical class of organic compounds built around a fused bicyclic core in which a benzene ring is joined to a seven-membered diazepine ring containing two nitrogen atoms, the classic 1,4-diazepine arrangement. Most members additionally carry a pendant phenyl ring and varied substituents such as chlorine, nitro or fluorine groups, which distinguish individual compounds. Benzodiazepines act as positive modulators at the GABA-A receptor, producing sedative, anxiolytic, muscle-relaxant and anticonvulsant effects. Fusing a triazole or imidazole ring onto the diazepine gives rise to several closely related subgroups.

legacy.56348726408579d1d3bda155164178bf3.catalogKey: Substituted pyrrolidines are a chemical class of organic compounds in which the amine nitrogen is incorporated into a five-membered pyrrolidine ring. In the psychoactive pyrrolidinophenones they retain the cathinone framework, a benzene ring linked to an alpha-methyl sidechain bearing a beta-keto group, but the terminal amine is replaced by this pyrrolidine ring. Members vary by ring substituents, by the length of the alkyl chain on the sidechain, and by whether a methylenedioxy bridge is present on the aromatic ring. These compounds typically act as potent stimulants through inhibition of dopamine and noradrenaline reuptake.

legacy.56537bc59134dd4c9bd2e8591496281a4.catalogKey: Beta-carbolines are a chemical class of organic compounds derived from the core tryptamine structure, formed by ring closure between the indole and the ethylamine chain to give a tricyclic system. Members carry various substituents on the resulting ring system. The harmala alkaloids among them act as reversible inhibitors of monoamine oxidase A, a role central to the pharmacology of ayahuasca, where they allow orally ingested tryptamines to remain active. The tricyclic indole-fused ring closure is the defining feature of the class.

legacy.627f81087220bfb852e26d8fcadf7d0d3.catalogKey: The x-NBOMe compounds are a chemical class of organic compounds derived from the core 2C-x phenethylamine structure. They are 2C-x phenethylamines in which a benzyl group bearing a methoxy substituent, an N-2-methoxybenzyl group, has been attached to the amine nitrogen, hence the name NBOMe. The core keeps the 2,5-dimethoxy benzene ring and 4-position substituent of the parent 2C compound, with the added N-benzyl arm being the distinguishing structural change. This N-benzyl addition dramatically increases affinity at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, making the class potent and long-acting psychedelics.

legacy.6322e3c83d89272748e766d1be61b17a4.catalogKey: Dissociatives are a class of hallucinogen which distort perceptions of sight and sound to produce feelings of disconnection, detachment, and dissociation from the environment and self. These effects occur due to the way in which these compounds function as NMDA receptor antagonists. This means they bind to receptors in the brain but do not activate them, thus blocking other neurotransmitters from doing so. The result is a dose-dependent decrease in the passing of electrical signals across the brain and an overall disconnection of neurons, which leads to states of disconnection between conscious parts of the brain and its sensory organs.

legacy.63c1b02c3758d0400187c0f6c0f077e8e.catalogKey:
Transpersonal effects are defined as any subjective effect that feels as if it alters a person's cognition in a manner that relates to their place in the universe, the inner workings of reality or consciousness, and/or the context of their existence. The highest manifestations of these effects fall under what are commonly known as "peak", "transcendent" or "transformative" experiences.

These effects are typically associated with high dose psychedelic or dissociative experiences. They can occur regardless of the person's spiritual or religious beliefs and often have a distinct and lasting impact on the user's perspective of the world around them. During the experience of a substance-induced transpersonal state, the information conveyed is often felt to be a real and objective truth. However, the person will often come to disagree with these supposed "epiphanies" once the effects of the substance have worn off.

It should be noted that these mind-states are the least reproducible of all effects within the Subjective Effect Index. Simply taking more of a given substance does not necessarily increase the chances of having these states occur. Instead, they seem to rely more on contextual factors, such as the person's set and setting.

This page lists the various transpersonal effects that can occur under the influence of certain psychoactive compounds.

legacy.773d0e4d2d8f1a4802a63765604bfa5e5.catalogKey: Barbiturates are a chemical class of organic compounds built on a barbituric acid core, a six-membered ring containing two nitrogen atoms and three carbonyl groups, formed by combining urea with a malonic acid unit. The thiobarbiturates are a close variant in which one ring oxygen is replaced by a sulfur atom.

The result is a dose-dependent decrease in the passing of electrical signals across the brain and an overall disconnection of neurons, which leads to states of disconnection between conscious parts of the brain and its sensory organs.

legacy.833fe8e8da41023e878a33df14adea881.catalogKey: Substituted benzofurans are a chemical class of organic compounds derived from the core phenethylamine structure and based on the benzofuran ring system, a benzene ring fused to a five-membered oxygen-containing furan ring. In the psychoactive members this fused ring system replaces the methylenedioxyphenyl portion of compounds like MDA, with an aminopropyl sidechain attached. They are therefore close structural relatives of the amphetamines and phenethylamines, differing mainly by the benzofuran ring in place of a simpler substituted benzene. Most members behave as entactogens or stimulants with a serotonergic character.

legacy.8569cd3b2f0c66d111e61160b13719d4b.catalogKey: **Stimulants** (also known as "uppers") are a class of psychoactive substances that speed up the central nervous system. The name comes from the Latin *stimulare*, which means "to goad on."

legacy.8ff528fbe73fa8f7365139223a2031e0d.catalogKey: Gabapentinoids are a chemical class of organic compounds that are structural analogues of the neurotransmitter GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid), built around the same short amino-acid chain but with a lipophilic group added at the 3-position of that backbone. The addition may be a cyclohexane ring fused onto the chain or a branched alkyl group, making the members 3-substituted GABA derivatives. Pharmacologically they act at the alpha-2-delta subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels, producing anxiolytic, anticonvulsant and sedating effects. This shared GABA backbone with a bulky lipophilic substituent is the structural thread linking the class.

legacy.90b9860e4afaa4b39b88228057f1c1e4a.catalogKey: **Opioids** are a class of psychoactive substances that relieve pain and produce euphoria, relaxation, and contentment. They also cause sedation. At high doses, opioids slow breathing to a dangerous degree. Opioids imitate endorphins, the natural painkilling chemicals of the body, and act on the same opioid receptors. The name comes from *opium*, the extract of the poppy, and *-oid* ("resembling"). The term "opiate" covers only natural poppy derivatives, but "opioid" covers any substance that acts on these receptors.

legacy.91b3080b9e81c7888cb1b08a9053a00e6.catalogKey: Pyrrolidinophenones are a chemical class of organic compounds derived from the core cathinone structure, in which the amine nitrogen is enclosed within a five-membered pyrrolidine ring. They retain the beta-keto aryl framework of the cathinones, with the pyrrolidine ring replacing the terminal amine and variable ring and sidechain substituents distinguishing the members. Most pyrrolidinophenones act as potent inhibitors of dopamine and noradrenaline reuptake, producing strong stimulant effects. The pyrrolidine ring on a cathinone backbone is the defining feature of the class.

legacy.92e56a9d375d169cdbf9ffd0682bdc90d.catalogKey: Substituted phenethylamines are a chemical class of organic compounds derived from the core phenethylamine structure. Phenethylamines are derived from a phenyl ring that is joined to an amino group via a two-carbon ethyl sidechain. Members of the class are produced by adding substituents to the aromatic ring, to the sidechain carbons, or to the amine nitrogen. Most substituted phenethylamines are psychoactive substances which behave across a wide range of categories, including stimulants, hallucinogens and entactogens. Many endogenous compounds, including catecholamines such as dopamine and noradrenaline, are phenethylamines.

legacy.98d50d6c9e074ea5f071c5cb5162f9afc.catalogKey:
The official Effect Index community is hosted on Discord and may be joined [here.]({{discordInvite}})

This a semi-private community and is not primarily for general conversation; instead, it aims to be a place of discussion and co-operation for progressing the field of formalised subjective effect documentation. For this reason, we tend to only invite people who genuinely want to contribute to the project. This can include anyone from proofreaders, trip reporters, web developers, programmers, replicators, artists, and more.

If you have an interest in contributing to and taking part in our community's various projects, please contact us within the public waiting room channel and tell us why you are interested in this project. Thanks!

legacy.a68b362e9a8dbfb6ec4e439f817adb9c0.catalogKey: The MDxx compounds are a chemical class of organic compounds derived from the core phenethylamine and amphetamine structures, built around a methylenedioxy bridge, a small ring fused across the 3,4-positions of the benzene ring, which is the feature the "MD" prefix points to. They share this 3,4-methylenedioxy phenyl group attached to an alpha-methyl amphetamine sidechain, differing mainly in the group on the amine nitrogen. Most MDxx compounds act as entactogens, releasing serotonin alongside dopamine and noradrenaline. The methylenedioxy ring is what distinguishes the family from the plain amphetamines and phenethylamines it is otherwise derived from.

legacy.b84ae248c646dc45c5758c8ffb955e350.catalogKey:
The factual knowledge within substance articles draw on decades of documentation by scientists, psychonauts, and the harm-reduction community, gathered from [ten harm-reduction and reference resources](/docs/how#sources). Each article links to the source pages that informed it.

Substance articles were drafted by LLMs, with dosage information transcribed by software from online tables. Real life human beings then reviewed and carefully edited each output over the course of months. The [how articles are made](/docs/how) explains the process in depth.

So, why did we use LLMs as part of this process? This was done for several reasons, but primarily speed, practicality, and reproducibility. Josie Kins, a co-founder of this project, the founder of PsychonautWiki, and numerous other similar projects, has real-world experience hand-crafting substance encyclopedias with teams of human beings. We know what it takes. It is an incredibly arduous and long term process. For example, the first draft of psychonautwiki took an entire community of people from 2011-2016. With incredibly few people reliably sticking around, and their workflows always leaving with them. Our community doesn't need a modern and open platform in 5 years from now. We need one yesterday.

This is why factual knowledge from across the internet was carefully scraped from online resources, assembled into either mechanistic parsers or an LLM synthesis pipeline, and aggregated into a single beautifully machine readable dataset, for anybody to download. A process that was followed by months of human review before we felt comfortable publishing it, and in total took about a year to complete. We deeply care about what we are doing here, and are now building as humans on top of this new open standard.

**dose.wiki is in beta.** Each article’s **Article Status** section tracks its progress and identifies whether it has been human-reviewed. Review is essential to trustworthiness: reviewers verify pharmacology, check dosage and interactions for potentially harmful errors, and add corrections, references, and their own explanations. Errors can have serious real-world consequences, so we welcome anyone able to submit feedback via the forms at the bottom of each substance article!

The other collections are entirely human-created:

- **Effect articles** form the [Subjective Effect Index](/effects), written over more than a decade across several websites.
- **Replications** depict the subjective appearance of experiences through artwork, mostly by members of Reddit’s [r/replications](https://reddit.com/r/replications) community.
- **Trip reports** are written by their authors and reviewed by an editor before publication.

The site and dataset continue to evolve toward 1.0. Check back for updates, or [send questions, comments, and corrections](#contact).

legacy.b9ca3788576f6a3dd48c68710b18126ee.catalogKey: Morphinans are a chemical class of organic compounds built on a fused tetracyclic carbon skeleton derived from the morphine framework, including a partially hydrogenated phenanthrene core with a nitrogen-containing ring bridged across it. Members differ by which oxygen-bearing groups sit on the rings, by the presence or absence of an oxygen bridge linking two rings, and by the substituent on the nitrogen. Most morphinans act at opioid receptors, functioning as analgesics, though the exact profile ranges from full agonists to antagonists. The morphine molecule itself, along with codeine and many semi-synthetic opioids, is a variation on this shared rigid scaffold.

legacy.be819960074f184e5357327469373dd94.catalogKey:
Effect Index serves as the platform for the [Subjective Effect Index (SEI)](/effects), a resource containing formalised documentation of the vast number of distinct subjective states that may occur under the influence of hallucinogens. We strive to comprehensively document and describe the wide variety of potential hallucinogenic experiences. The SEI is presented in an easily readable format that contains not only descriptions, but also image, video, and audio [replications](/replications) of these effects.

We believe that in pioneering formalised subjective effect documentation, we may demystify the psychedelic experience. This has the potential to allow hallucinogen usage to become more culturally acceptable, better understood, and create a platform on top of which these substances may be more easily studied.

Effect Index was initially founded as a side project on 30 June, 2017 by [Josie Kins](/contributors/josie), the founder of [PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.org) and [DisregardEverythingISay](https://disregardeverythingisay.com/). It serves as a platform for content that has been in constant development for the previous six years on these sites. However, the aforementioned content is now hosted on its own dedicated platform with the hope of further spreading the documentation and creating a universal terminology set that gives people the vernacular to fully describe experiences that were previously considered ineffable.

If you find this project interesting, we encourage you to join our active communities within both our [subreddit](https://reddit.com/r/replications) and our [Discord](/discord).

legacy.c1611ec808f68715ab5aed1dc1f89933a.catalogKey: Aminoindanes are a chemical class of organic compounds and conformationally rigid analogues of amphetamine in which the flexible sidechain is locked into a ring. The indane system, a benzene ring fused to a five-membered carbocyclic ring, carries the amino group on that saturated ring, typically at the 2-position. Members differ by substituents on the aromatic ring, including a methylenedioxy bridge or a halogen, and by N-alkylation. Depending on substitution, members act as stimulants or as more serotonergic entactogens, and tying the amphetamine backbone into the indane ring is what defines and rigidifies the class.

legacy.cfb85478b8e9cd869bba951d889cbaa46.catalogKey: **Dissociatives** are a subclass of hallucinogen that produce a feeling of detachment from the body, the sense of self, and the surroundings. Dissociatives mainly block NMDA receptors, which are part of the glutamate system. This system binds sensory information and the sense of self into one coherent experience. The block interrupts this system and creates the sense of disconnection. At low doses, the effect is a floaty, dreamlike state. At high doses, the effect is a full out-of-body experience.

legacy.d10c78083a2066846c5ca50a22c7a122a.catalogKey: Deliriants are a class of hallucinogen that are unique in that they offer solid hallucinations which display themselves seamlessly into waking consciousness, similar to fully formed dreams. These hallucinations are also characterised by delusions and psychosis as they are most often immediately accepted as reality by the person experiencing them. In contrast, classical psychedelics and dissociatives have progressive levels of multiple all-encompassing sensory effects before reaching the level of concrete hallucination. They also rarely induce psychosis, with most people maintaining an understanding that they are simply under the influence of a substance throughout any hallucinations which they undergo.

legacy.d39b029aa2719d9c854bf98f71323102e.catalogKey: Substituted cathinones are a chemical class of organic compounds derived from the core amphetamine structure. Cathinones are the beta-keto analogues of amphetamines, sharing the alpha-methylphenethylamine backbone but adding a ketone group at the beta carbon of the sidechain, the carbon adjacent to the benzene ring. legacy.d3f6649169f924448c0043a657a99f9ad.catalogKey:
Disconnective effects are any subjective effect which feels as if it detaches or disconnects one from the external environment, their senses, and their consciousness.

These effects are typically associated with dissociative hallucinogens and likely occur due to the way in which these compounds function as NMDA receptor antagonists. This means they bind to the receptor, but do not activate it and block other neurotransmitters from doing so. The result is a dose-dependent decrease in the passing of electrical signals across the brain and an overall disconnection of neurons, which leads to states of disconnection between conscious parts of the brain and its sensory organs.

legacy.d5cd038f1b962ec39472e3f1c607c338e.catalogKey: Substituted tryptamines are a chemical class of organic compounds built around an indole ring system, a benzene ring fused to a five-membered nitrogen-containing pyrrole ring, with an aminoethyl sidechain attached at the indole 3-position. Individual members differ mainly in what is attached to the terminal amine nitrogen and in substituents on the indole ring, such as a hydroxyl or phosphoryloxy group at the 4-position or a methoxy group at the 5-position. Most psychoactive tryptamines act as serotonergic hallucinogens, though the class also includes non-psychoactive relatives. The neurotransmitter serotonin shares this same tryptamine backbone, which is why the class is often described in relation to it.

legacy.d77c47fb53c632ad3c282d006659a7f77.catalogKey: Thiopropamines are a chemical class of organic compounds derived from the core amphetamine structure in which the benzene ring is replaced by a thiophene ring, a five-membered sulfur-containing aromatic ring. The sulfur-for-carbon ring swap is a classic bioisosteric substitution, leaving the alpha-methyl amine sidechain otherwise intact. Members act as stimulants, behaving much like their amphetamine counterparts. The thiophene ring in place of a benzene ring is the single feature that defines the class.

legacy.e282d186dcc73204fe55c127eae48b100.catalogKey:
Hey everyone, [Josie Kins](https://josiekins.xyz) here.

It recently came to my attention that the biggest psychoactive substance encyclopedia in China is a translation of [PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.rip), a website I founded back in 2013. I'm not involved in [PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.rip) these days; it sort of slowly died after I left it in 2017.

I think it's great that you translated it into Chinese. As a gift, I'd like to present the people of China and [FreeODwiki](https://freeodwiki.org/) with the dose.wiki dataset, fully translated into Simplified Chinese, for you to use. It's in JSON, which is easily machine-readable. I also took a look at your [GitHub repo](https://github.com/SalviaSWC/FreeODwiki) and took the liberty of converting it into a FreeODwiki Markdown-compatible format.

Included are:

- The entire substance index, which I believe is more comprehensive than [PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.rip)'s.
- The entire subjective effect index, which is definitely more up to date than the one on [PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.rip), because I've continued to work on it.
- SVG molecule packs.
- Various articles I've written over the years on dreams, lucid dreaming, psychedelic effects, substance effects, lots of little things like that.

I took all the prose from the website and put it into nice, easily downloadable packs for you.

I think this will be great to supplement the material you already have. There's a lot more on [PsychonautWiki](https://psychonautwiki.rip) outside these narrow databases, like articles on neurotransmitters and mechanisms in the brain, chemistry articles, harm reduction articles, and we don't have equivalents to those on dose.wiki yet. But the substance articles that are there are just a lot more comprehensive and standardised than the ones on PsychonautWiki. I basically made a pipeline that takes all the actual information online about a psychoactive substance and synthesises it. Take 4-AcO-DMT: there are maybe ten articles about it across ten different major English-language substance encyclopedias, and the pipeline folds them into one. That's why there's more information per substance on dose.wiki, and why it's so much more standardised.

There's also more in there than PsychonautWiki ever had: reagent test information, subjective effect information, a broader array of substances, more detailed history and culture sections, TripSit interaction and combination data so it's easier to look up and avoid dangerous combinations, and legality sections that are way more comprehensive than anything on the old PsychonautWiki. This is a 0.9 beta, by the way, and there's a lot more coming.

I've been thinking for a while about having translations on dose.wiki itself, but when it came down to it, I don't think it's very sensible for me to be managing web infrastructure for substance information for a nation and culture that, as a silly Westerner, is honestly quite mysterious to me. So I figured I'd fork the dataset in its current form and send it over.

I used GLM 5.3 Flash to translate this, and it only cost about a dollar. If you'd rather have Traditional Chinese, just let me know. We have another 250 substance articles on the way, but we haven't done human review of those yet, so we're waiting; I definitely don't want to give you AI slop. I'll update this as they land.

That's the gist of it. Enjoy. I won't be offended if you don't use it, but I figured it might come in handy. Obviously I don't speak Chinese, but online translation is a thing. Feel free to hit me up on Twitter anytime if you have questions. Happy to work with you. :) <3

I've been thinking for a while about having translations on dose.wiki itself, but when it came down to it, I don't think it's very sensible for me to be managing web infrastructure for substance information for a nation and culture that, as a silly Westerner, is honestly quite mysterious to me. So I figured I'd fork the dataset in its current form and send it over.

I used GLM 5.3 Flash to translate this, and it only cost about a dollar. If you'd rather have Traditional Chinese, just let me know. We have another 250 substance articles on the way, but we haven't done human review of those yet, so we're waiting; I definitely don't want to give you AI slop. I'll update this as they land.

That's the gist of it. Enjoy. I won't be offended if you don't use it, but I figured it might come in handy. Obviously I don't speak Chinese, but online translation is a thing. Feel free to hit me up on Twitter anytime if you have questions. Happy to work with you. :) <3
